Yara (FinOps): Follow-up from the postmortem: delayed batch replay caused ~+10% token inflation for 5 customers. Need owners for backfill, invoice adjustments, recurrence detection, and customer comms. Who can take what?
Ethan (Eng): Ill own the backfill and add a dedupe guard. Plan: small patch today, staging smoke tonight, prod backfill tomorrow 05:00 UTC.
Sana (Metering): Ill do recurrence detection + dashboards. Proposal: page on >=8% in 2h; slack warning on >=4% in 24h. Add 2-window confirmation to reduce noise.
Vik (SRE): Ill own ledger reconcile & invoice reissue tooling. Need the impacted customer CSV and a dry-run window.
Yara (FinOps): Uploaded impacted_customers.csv to FIN-900 and queued a reissue job. billing-bot: br-2034567890 queued (FIN-900).
billing-bot: Reissue job queued id=br-2034567890 status=pending (FIN-900).
Ethan (Eng): Quick validation query Ill run on staging:
```
SELECT customer_id, date_trunc('hour', ts) hr, SUM(tokens) tokens
FROM token_events
WHERE ts >= now() - interval '7 days'
GROUP BY customer_id, hr
ORDER BY tokens DESC
LIMIT 20;
```
Ethan (Eng): Staging smoke ok; root cause = retry reprocessed two shard windows. Patch landed in canary. Backfill scheduled tomorrow 05:00 UTC.
Sana (Metering): PR opened for detection + dashboard: github.com/redwood/meters/pull/777. Ill add example notebooks for borderline cases.
Vik (SRE): Draft reconcile script at //ops/billing/reconcile_dryrun.sh. Dry-run Mon 09:00 UTC. Will include pro-rata credit calc and rollback toggle.
Yara (FinOps): Recap: Ethan - patch + staging (today), prod backfill (tomorrow 05:00 UTC). Sana - detection rules + dashboards (Fri AM). Vik - reconcile script + dry-run (Mon 09:00 UTC). Finance will draft comms after dry-run. Please post status updates here so I can close FIN-900 once actions complete. :thumbsup:
